verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device AI SDK and CLI, so autonomous background automations are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence shows nothing about scheduled, recurring or background-running automations. The SDK's tool-calling loop and voice-agent session are developer building blocks or interactive features, not a user-facing automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
